about_the_game:
The Ancient Cultivatrix: Weapons DLC includes:
• new weapons: hammer, stick, etc.

※ This product does not include the base game. Players who already own the digital standard edition of Ancient Cultivatrix will receive the above weapons after purchasing this upgrade pack.
※ After unlocking the corresponding weapons in the early game, these weapons can be triggered during battles.
※ All content in this product features weapons and battle skills. The development team will update these features in future patches.
